import sys,importlib.util,json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,urllib.error,time
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m","/root/direct-sync/maersk_track_sync.py")
sys.argv=["x"]; m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
env=m.load_env(); tok=m.maersk_token(env)
def try_call(url,params):
    q=urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    r=urllib.request.Request(url+"?"+q,headers={"Consumer-Key":env["MAERSK_CONSUMER_KEY"],
      "Authorization":"Bearer "+tok,"Accept":"application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=60) as x:
            b=x.read().decode()
            js=json.loads(b or "{}")
            ev=js.get("events",js) if isinstance(js,dict) else js
            n=len(ev) if isinstance(ev,list) else "?"
            return "%s подій=%s %s"%(x.status,n,b[:120].replace("\n"," "))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return "HTTP %s | %s"%(e.code,e.read().decode()[:200].replace("\n"," "))
    except Exception as e:
        return "ERR %s"%str(e)[:120]
PRIV=m.EVENTS_URL; PUB=m.EVENTS_URL_PUBLIC
for label,url,params in [
  ("privat  booking     ",PRIV,{"carrierBookingReference":"269554674"}),
  ("privat  BL(transport)",PRIV,{"transportDocumentReference":"269554674"}),
  ("privat  контейнер   ",PRIV,{"equipmentReference":"TRHU6315257"}),
  ("публічн BL(transport)",PUB,{"transportDocumentReference":"269554674"}),
  ("публічн booking     ",PUB,{"carrierBookingReference":"269554674"}),
  ("публічн контейнер   ",PUB,{"equipmentReference":"TRHU6315257"}),
]:
    print(label,"->",try_call(url,params)); time.sleep(1.5)
EOF
